name: screen-mcp
description: Eyes and hands on a Linux Wayland desktop: screenshot any monitor and click, type, scroll, drag, and read any visible app over xdg-desktop-portal (RemoteDesktop + ScreenCast), with optional OCR + OmniParser icon grounding. Pure-Python, CPU-only. GNOME/Wayland only. Ships the MCP server plus a drive-screen skill that encodes the locate-ground-act-confirm loop.
